title: Graham Hancock's lost Ice Age civilization

tellings.quote: Graham thinks this is these were built by um ancient peoples the Atlanteanss or whoever

plain: The writer Graham Hancock thinks ancient sites such as Göbekli Tepe, a very old stone temple site in Turkey, were built by a lost Ice Age people, "the Atlanteans or whoever." The skeptic Michael Shermer sums up Hancock's view, which Hancock set out in his book Fingerprints of the Gods, published in 1995. If true, civilization would be far older than the textbooks say.
